scope: Routing recommendations only; candidate preference is not backend approval or automatic runtime dispatch.

informal_firered.observation: Approximately one failure in four manual attempts. Outfit changes, body morphing and similar existing-image modifications are mostly successful. Failures primarily involve incomplete instruction-following. Outpainting is unreliable and can cause severe body-proportion errors, including abnormally shortened limbs.
informal_firered.limitations: No controlled sample, complete attempt log, fixed case mix, or predeclared scoring. Do not convert the approximate three-in-four impression into a formal benchmark or validated pass rate.
